Japan visa application for **P1 only**. When filling in the form, use Day/Month/Year for dates. If a passport date is printed in a different format, rearrange it by hand.

```text
[B01] Surname
SURNAME_P1

[B02] Given and middle names
GIVEN_P1
MIDDLE_P1
Enter both on the same line in the order shown in your passport.

[B03] Other names
NEEDS-YOU — Enter any other names you have used, or confirm none.

[B04] Date of birth
DATE_P1

[B05] Place of birth
PLACE_P1
Arrange the entry by hand as city, state or province, and country.
NEEDS-YOU — Supply any of those parts missing from the stored value.

[B06] Sex
Male

[B07] Marital status
Married

[B08] Nationality or citizenship
Indian

[B09] Former or other nationalities or citizenships
NEEDS-YOU — Enter any former or other citizenships, or confirm none.

[B10] Government-issued ID number
NEEDS-YOU — Enter the government-issued ID number for this field.

[B11] Passport type
NEEDS-YOU — Check your passport and select its type.

[B12] Passport number
ID_P1

[B13] Place of issue
NEEDS-YOU — Enter the place of issue shown in your passport.
The issuing country is India.

[B14] Date of issue
ISSUED_P1

[B15] Issuing authority
AUTHORITY_P1

04/06/2029

NEEDS-YOU — Enter the number if this field applies to you.

NEEDS-YOU — Enter the name of your airline.

NEEDS-YOU — Enter the name and telephone number of your hotel or host.

[B24] Accommodation address
NEEDS-YOU — Enter the address of your hotel or host.

[B25] Previous stays in Japan
One stay of 9 days in October 2023.
NEEDS-YOU — Add the exact arrival and departure dates.

[B26] Current residential address
ADDRESS_P1
NEEDS-YOU — Add any other current residential addresses, if applicable.

[B27] Telephone and mobile number
PHONE_P1
Put this number in Tel. or Mobile No. according to its type.

NEEDS-YOU — Enter your email address.

[B29] Current occupation and position
Software engineer

NEEDS-YOU — Enter your employer's name and telephone number.

NEEDS-YOU — Enter your employer's address.

[B33] Guarantor or reference in Japan
NEEDS-YOU — If applicable, enter their name, telephone, address,
date of birth, sex, relationship to you, occupation and position,

NEEDS-YOU — If applicable, enter the inviter's name, telephone,
address, date of birth, sex, relationship to you, occupation and

if the inviter is also the guarantor.

NEEDS-YOU — Add any remarks or special circumstances you wish to disclose.

[B36] Conviction for a crime or offence
NEEDS-YOU — Select Yes or No.

NEEDS-YOU — Select Yes or No, following Note 2 on suspended sentences.

NEEDS-YOU — Select Yes or No.

NEEDS-YOU — Select Yes or No, following Note 2 on suspended sentences.

NEEDS-YOU — Select Yes or No.

NEEDS-YOU — Select Yes or No.

NEEDS-YOU — Enter the actual application date.

[B44] Applicant's signature
```
